INVALID_INPUT: Some information is missing or invalid. Check the form and try again.
SIGN_IN_FAILED: We could not sign you in. Check your email and password. If needed, reset your password or check your verification email.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
NOT_ALLOWED: You do not have permission to do this. Return to the previous page or contact the group administrator.
NOT_AVAILABLE: This content is unavailable. It may have been removed or you may not have access. Return to the previous page.
CONFLICT: This action could not be completed because something has changed or already exists. Refresh the page and check before trying again.
ACCOUNT_CONFLICT: We could not create or update this account with those details. Check your username. If you already have an account, sign in or reset your password.
LINK_EXPIRED: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new link and use the latest email.
ADMIN_TRANSFER_REQUIRED: Choose another group administrator before leaving, removing yourself or deactivating your account.
POLL_CLOSED: This poll has ended. You can view the results, but voting is closed.
ALREADY_VOTED: You have already voted in this poll. Refresh to see the results.
ALREADY_CONNECTED: You are already connected to this student. Refresh to see the current connection.
ACADEMIC_EXISTS: This faculty or department is already listed. Select the existing option.
ACADEMIC_PENDING: This faculty or department is already awaiting review. Select an existing option or wait for review.
REVIEW_COMPLETE: This request has already been reviewed. Refresh to see the latest status.
UPLOAD_PROCESSING: Your file is still being processed. Wait a moment, then try again.
UPLOAD_EXPIRED: Your upload has expired. Select the file again and retry.
INVALID_FILE: This file could not be accepted. Choose a supported, complete file and try again.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file or request is too large. Images must be under 10 MB, videos under 100 MB and documents under 50 MB.
STORAGE_LIMIT: Your upload allowance has been reached. Contact support before uploading more files.
EVENT_ENDED: This event has ended. Responses can no longer be changed.
REGISTRATION_ID_INVALID: We could not recognize your registration number. Check its format and contact support if it is correct.
CREDENTIAL_CONFIRMATION: We could not confirm your current password. Check it and try again.
MESSAGES_UNAVAILABLE: You cannot message this student right now. They may have restricted messages. Choose another conversation.
RATE_LIMITED: You have made several requests in a short time. Wait a minute before trying again.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: This feature is temporarily unavailable. Try again later. If the problem continues, contact support.
REALTIME_UNAVAILABLE: Live updates are temporarily unavailable. Your conversations will still refresh automatically.
REFRESH_REQUIRED: This list has changed or your pagination link has expired. Refresh the page to continue.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong while completing your request. Try again later. If the problem continues, contact support.
NETWORK_ERROR: We could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
INVALID_EMAIL: Enter a valid email address, then try again.
INVALID_USERNAME: Use a username with 3–30 letters, numbers or underscores.
INVALID_PASSWORD: Choose a password with at least 12 characters and no more than 72 bytes.
INVALID_DISPLAY_NAME: Enter a display name between 1 and 100 characters.
INVALID_REGISTRATION_NUMBER: Enter the registration number shown on your student record. Check the faculty code, admission year, department code and sequence number.
NETWORK_WRITE_ERROR: We could not confirm whether your action completed. Check your connection, refresh and check for changes before submitting again.
SELF_ACTION: Choose another student. You cannot follow, connect with or start a conversation with yourself.
GROUP_REQUIRED: Choose a group before publishing this announcement.
INVALID_AUDIENCE: Check the selected audience. A campus-wide post or event cannot also be restricted to a group.
EVENT_SCOPE_FIXED: An existing event’s group and audience cannot be changed. Edit its other details or create a new event.
ACADEMIC_LIMIT: You have ten academic requests awaiting review. Wait for a decision before submitting another.
UPLOAD_LIMIT: You have several uploads in progress. Finish or wait for them before uploading more files.
REGISTRATION_COHORT_UNSUPPORTED: Your department or admission year is not yet enabled for registration. Contact support so your student registration details can be reviewed. Changing your number will not fix this.
ACADEMIC_SELECTION_INVALID: Choose a department from the selected faculty and your current study level. Refresh the page if the options have changed.
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Verify your email address before signing in. You can request a new verification link.
ACCOUNT_DELETED: This account was permanently deleted and cannot be reactivated.
WATCH_SEARCH_LIMIT: You have reached the video search limit for this hour. Try again later, or revisit videos in your library.
WATCH_UNAVAILABLE: Campus videos are temporarily unavailable. You can still browse your saved library. Try again later.
WATCH_LIBRARY_LIMIT: Your library has reached its limit. Remove a playlist or playlist video before adding another.
